label: microQ ROM
description: Vavra needs the firmware of your own Waldorf microQ: a 512 kB flash dump (.bin), or the microQ OS 2.23 update file (mq_2_23.mid).
hint: Any file name works. The OS update file has no factory sounds: banks A to C then start empty.

rules.label: microQ flash ROM (512 kB)
rules.note: The right size for a microQ flash dump. Vavra checks the firmware when it loads.

rules.label: microQ OS update (.mid)
rules.note: Looks like a microQ OS update. Vavra checks it when it loads.

label: microQ sound sets
description: Optional: your own microQ sound sets as SysEx (.syx) or MIDI (.mid) files with single sound dumps. Each one adds banks of 100 sounds after ROM banks A, B and C.
hint: Waldorf's factory sets 2000 and 2001 and the Forum sets work; subfolders are fine.

rules.label: MIDI file with SysEx dumps
rules.note: Vavra uses only the microQ sound dumps inside it; it checks them when it loads.
